title: dsh-claude-style design tokens
description: The skin's custom properties: the build generates the token stylesheet and the docs/STYLE.md tables from this document (D9, D30).

typeface.description: Font tokens: `claude` under the Claude typeface, `system` under System sans, `host` under the host's.

apex.description: The reasoning slider's accent colours — its matrix and knob glow, and the trigger's ramp — mixed from the accent of the palette in force.

palette.description: The colour cards, the tone ladder every colour token is a step of, and the tokens themselves.

cards.description: The looks a reader can pick; the first card is the default.

edges.description: How a dark canvas draws its outlines: a lit highlight or a flat surface step.

logoInk.description: What the sidebar's brand art is drawn in before the reader's own image-colour choice.

tones.description: The ladder: every colour token is one step of a seed's own hue.

tokens.description: Every colour token: the tone it paints, a literal, an alias, or the card's own trait.

flat.description: The rung a card with flat contours reads instead, in the scheme the tone names.

schemes.description: The schemes this token paints; every scheme when absent.

use.description: What the token paints, for the docs/STYLE.md table.

motion.description: Motion tokens (D9): durations, loop periods, easing curves, distances, blur and scale, and the two duration-and-curve shorthands. One value under every card and typeface; the only place a stylesheet may write a time or a curve.

use.description: The role the token plays, for the docs/STYLE.md motion table.

layer.description: Layer tokens (D9): the stacking levels a skin surface takes against what the host draws around it. One value under every card and typeface; the only place a stylesheet may write a z-index above the local orders 0 to 9.

use.description: What stands on this level and what it has to clear, for the docs/STYLE.md layer table.

note.description: Why the value has this shape; kept for maintainers, not emitted.

tone.description: One step of a seed: the seed it reads, a lightness offset, a chroma offset or multiple, a hue shift and, where the surface is translucent, an alpha.

seed.description: A card seed (canvas, accent, link) or a tone declared above this one.

hue.description: A seed whose hue the rung takes instead of its own, for an ink that keeps the canvas's warmth.

l.description: An absolute lightness, for a rung the seed's own lightness cannot place (a tint on both cards).

dc.description: Added to the seed's own chroma, so a card keeps its family's saturation.

c.description: An absolute chroma, for a rung that must not follow the card's saturation.
